run_download_tatoeba_speech: run the script to download Tatoeba speech MP3 files for multiple languages into a root directory
run_download_mp3_single: run the _download_mp3 function to download a single MP3 file from Tatoeba audio by sentence ID
run_download_all_languages: run the main function to download speech MP3s for all six supported languages from TSV files
refactor_download_mp3_retry: refactor the _download_mp3 function to add retry logic for failed downloads
review_lang_code_mapping: review the LANG_CODE_2_TO_3 mapping to add support for additional language codes
